title: Other practice surfaces
intro: Beyond messaging and ingest, the same harness shows up in how we decide, speak, parallelise, share designs, and keep specs honest.

surfaces.title: Desktop MCQ dialogs
surfaces.body: Decision forks use a desktop multiple-choice dialog — not markdown A/B/C walls. Questions explain why the fork matters; dangerous arms are marked; the referent (draft/path) is visible in the ask.

surfaces.title: Voice notes both ways
surfaces.body: Inbound speech becomes text via STT; outbound can be short TTS when voice fits. Same trust and send rules as typed WhatsApp — voice is a medium, not a privilege escalation.

surfaces.title: Parallel agent lanes
surfaces.body: Named lanes with owns / never / handoffs. One writer per tree. MemPalace tickets for REQUEST/ACK/DONE when peers must coordinate.
surfaces.lesson: Team-shaped solo work needs explicit ownership.

surfaces.title: Tiered send authority
surfaces.body: Draft freely. Light carve-outs for trusted contexts; everything else fail-closed with a human gate showing the full message. No soft “shall I send?” stacks that hide the body.

surfaces.title: Design-share / Pages review
surfaces.body: Enclosure and product visuals move through a gated loop: generate → verify → share on GitHub Pages for Look/Inspect — so humans review atmosphere and fit without emailing mystery ZIPs.
surfaces.lesson: Share the review surface, not an ungoverned dump.

surfaces.title: Specification documents
surfaces.body: Git markdown is source of truth; branded DOCX/PDF are exports; Drive mirrors are for comments. Agents ingest doc comments back into the SoT — they do not treat the export as canonical.

surfaces.title: Convert / media pipeline
surfaces.body: Bounded convert steps turn office docs and media into text or intermediates for the task — instead of stuffing opaque binaries into every prompt.
surfaces.lesson: Convert with purpose; discard intermediates you will not keep.

surfaces.title: Brand as a skill
surfaces.body: Loadable brand procedures keep email, web, PDF, and UI on one visual and verbal system across agent sessions.

surfaces.title: Voice-turn confirm box
surfaces.body: Mic → local STT → human confirms the transcript before the agent treats speech as the ask.

surfaces.title: Secrets dialog
surfaces.body: Desktop capture into a vault; agents confirm success or length — never echo the secret.

surfaces.title: CI publish checks
surfaces.body: Content sync → automated content checks → Playwright UX. That pipeline is the publish proof class for this notebook.
